method.description: Classify each internal legacy _chunk_span boundary by whether it coincides with a canonical grid edge. Grid edges are labeled by the strongest paragraph, line, sentence, dialogue, or phrase transition. A boundary strictly inside one grid leaf is an emergency cut characterized by its preceding character.
method.purpose: Baseline measurement only. Counts and characterizations are migration evidence, not an acceptance threshold or a target percentage for the new packer.
